title: Route 4 after dark: what changes on 10 January, and what doesn't

speaker.name: Marta Lindqvist
speaker.about: one-question check: a Spanish question sent to an English-speaking speaker

notes: Regular trips: you can make a standing booking, for example the same pick-up every weekday after a shift. Set it up once by phone or in the app and it repeats until you cancel it.
interview: The drivers who work evening Route 4 today are being offered the Hop driving jobs with Tarn Mobility on the same pay. Nobody is being made redundant.
The booking phone line is answered by real people from 08:00 to 01:30 every day, with two call handlers in the evening. You do not need a smartphone or an email address to book.
Aldercote is left out because it is in the neighbouring district and Northfell District Council has not agreed to pay its share. We are still talking to them.
On bank holidays Hop runs to the Sunday hours.

audience.name: Lucía Fernández
audience.about: 34, hospital cleaner on late shifts that end at 00:45; types fast in Spanish with typos and abbreviations

asks.q: si el servicio acaba a las 00:30, q hacen los q salimos a esa hora?? lo van a ampliar??

replies.answer: Folding bikes, folded up, yes. Full-size bikes, no: the minibuses have no rack.

It is in the contract. Tarn Mobility must pick up at least 85% of bookings within 15 minutes each month; in any month below that it loses 5% of that month's fee. 9 in 10 is what we are aiming for on top.
